verdict.rationale: Data portability and exit are fair questions for a phone service, but the evidence documents no data export of call history, voicemail, or account data in open formats, and no port-out process. The porting evidence covers numbers transferring in to Community Phone. Voicemail-to-email and 'cancel anytime' are adjacent features, not a bulk data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
